title: Prakas on the Maintenance of Reserve Requirement Against Commercial Banks Deposits and Borrowings
text:
- Pursuant to the recommendation made by the National Bank of Cambodia Management
meeting on 17 August 2018.
Decides
Chapter I
General Provisions
Article 1.-
Commercial Banks shall maintain reserve requirements against deposits and borrowings
at a daily average balance equal to 8% (eight percent) in Riels and 12.5% (twelve point five
percent) in foreign currencies with the National Bank of Cambodia.
Article 2.-
Prakas No B7-012-140 Prokor dated September 13, 2012 of the Maintenance of Reserve
Requirement Against Commercial Banks’ Deposits and Borrowings is hereby repealed.
Article 3.-
The General Secretary, the General Director of Banking Supervision, the General
Director of Central Banking, the General Cashier, the General Inspector, Directors of all relevant
Departments in the National Bank of Cambodia and all Commercial Banks under the National
Bank of Cambodia’s supervisory authority shall strictly implement this Prakas.
Article 4.-
This Prakas shall have effect from the signing date.
Phnom Penh, August 29, 2018
The Governor
Signed and Sealed: Chea Chanto
To:
- As stated in article 3“for implementation”
- Files- archives
